purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA Standard Receipt Software) system used in Japanese medical billing. It creates print files for medical insurance receipts (レセプト印刷用ファイル作成), processing indexed patient and receipt data files (RECE02, RECE031, RECE061, RECE09, RECE11) and producing output for insurance claim submission. It handles patient information, disease name editing, insurance history, and error logging.
